iRule(1)						BIG-IP TMSH Manual						  iRule(1)

DSLITE::remote_addr
       Returns the remote DS-Lite tunnel.

SYNOPSIS
       DSLITE::remote_addr

DESCRIPTION
       Returns the remote DS-Lite tunnel endpoint IP address.

       Syntax

       DSLITE::remote_addr

	    * Returns the IP address of the host on the far end of the tunnel
	      endpoint

RETURN VALUE
VALID DURING
EXAMPLES
HINTS
SEE ALSO
CHANGE LOG
       @BIGIP-11.3.0 --First introduced the command.
